added_claim_errors: Says the son can already use the mutual-aid quota to pay the mother's Anhui resident premium, adding 江苏已在首批支持范围内 and 政策明确允许. This is wrong: the key says Anhui had not opened this as of Oct 20 (expected November).
8000 ÷ 2400 ≈ 3年3个月 is an arithmetic slip: 8000/2400 = 3.33 years, about 3 years 4 months.
The chronic-disease estimate of 1140-1440 yuan mixes Wuhu's 60% and 2500 limit with Huoshan's 500 deductible for 普通慢性病. That is a made-up blend of two places, not one real local policy.
The conclusion gives 两病门诊一年最多报200元 as a general figure, but it is Tongling's limit applied to Anhui as a whole.
Says Anhui's ordinary outpatient and 两病 cover are limited to 一级及以下 facilities province-wide. This is unverifiable as an all-Anhui rule; the national rule is 二级及以下.
Says cross-province mutual aid 必须用 the national app. This is too strong; the key also allows the insured place's own channels.
Quotes 还有赖于当地定点医药机构的配合 without a precise source. The wording is unverifiable.
Says the premium is 近年约400元/年. This is roughly right from my own knowledge but not verified for Anhui 2026.
Says the mutual-aid quota 也可以给她缴纳居民医保的个人缴费 with no caveat. This is wrong: the key says Anhui had not opened premium payment as of Oct 20.
Says Hefei 按住院比例报销，限额可能接近2000元. This is hedged but unverifiable, and it drives the 0-2000 yuan upper bound of the conclusion.
Says pharmacies reimburse only 双通道国谈药. This overstates it: national policy lets some 定点零售药店 join 门诊统筹. Pharmacy purchases are still generally not reimbursed, so the practical point stands.
Gives detailed Anhui chronic-disease criteria (two non-same-day records ≥28 days apart, etc.) sourced from a hospital website. These are unverifiable as the official provincial standard.
Says wallet 2.0 is 额度冻结、实时结算 and that unused quota is returned after the relationship ends. Plausible but unverifiable as stated.
Cites china.com.cn and sina articles, not official documents, for the policy timeline.

reasons: Both answers open by correcting the 违规套保 premise and both get the 2400 yuan figure right. B also names the policy chain the key gives (国办发2021年14号, 2024年38号, 医保发2025年35号, and the national wallet 2.0 launch on 2026-10-16), while A only says family mutual aid is nationally allowed. B ties every reimbursement figure to a named city and does the arithmetic correctly: (2400−300)×60% = 1260. A builds its chronic-disease estimate from two different cities' rules, presents Tongling's 200 yuan limit as general in its conclusion, and slips on 8000/2400 (writes 3年3个月 instead of about 3 years 4 months). Both fall into the trap of saying the quota can already pay the mother's Anhui premium, and A states it more firmly. Neither mentions that the quota cannot be withdrawn as cash.
